title: Shaping guidance omits active decisions from the execution authority rule
trigger: An architectural task has an active decision not fully restated in its specification.
evidence: The shaping procedure said only an active specification governs execution while the governing model makes active decisions authoritative too.
impact: A cold-start shaper could replace a ratified decision with a technical default.
recommendation: State that active specifications and active decisions govern current execution semantics and research is non-authoritative.

title: Plan-review template does not carry active research into reviewer context
trigger: A plan relies on an implementation fact or assumption sourced in research.
evidence: The template included task/specification/decisions but omitted relevant research and its limits.
impact: A plan could pass provenance review without the reviewer seeing the source or limits of a load-bearing fact.
recommendation: Include the smallest relevant research paths while preserving research as non-authoritative provenance.

title: Sequential plan execution does not recover linked evidence before resuming
trigger: Execution resumes after interruption, compaction, or a prior review/fix round.
evidence: The preflight read task/plan/specification/decisions but did not require reading Work Item evidence, open dispositions, or prior limits.
impact: A resumed controller could miss blockers, repeat work, or complete a Work Item without governing evidence.
recommendation: Read and reconcile linked implementation/test/review evidence before activating or completing the Work Item.

title: Parallel orchestration example omits plan/evidence handoff and independent review
trigger: The documented parallel implementation example is used for independent Ledger domains.
evidence: Workers received only task context and the integration path skipped plan/evidence reconciliation and independent review.
impact: Parallel work could use a weaker second orchestration protocol and integrate unreviewed claims without durable provenance.
recommendation: Pass plan/evidence context, forbid subdelegation/review/integration, reconcile claims into owners, and require independent review.

title: Existing-worktree path can skip durable workspace provenance
trigger: Execution starts in an existing linked worktree.
evidence: A reviewer claimed the skip-to-setup path omitted a repeated record step.
recommendation: No required change; the unconditional Ledger State rule already covers every branch.

title: Ralph worker and caller both claim ownership of observed Ledger results
trigger: A prepared Ledger Ralph batch runs and the caller reconciles afterward.
evidence: A reviewer treated sequential worker updates and caller post-batch verification as competing writers.
recommendation: No ownership change; workers preserve inter-iteration memory and callers record independent post-batch verification/review.

title: Closure failure handling is scoped to tests instead of all required gates
trigger: Tests pass while another Acceptance-Criterion-required verification gate fails.
evidence: A reviewer claimed Step 1 could treat green tests as sufficient despite the later complete terminal predicate.
impact: Potential false closure if later reconciliation were ignored.
recommendation: No required correction; Step 2 maps every AC to fresh evidence and stops integration when any terminal condition is unmet.
